residual_risks: Separate supplementary material to arXiv:2611.23223 was not retrieved; the later paper has exactly the same microscopic Gaussian payoff model for low dimensions and might hide an equivalent small-m result. Generic diagonal-dominance and Gershgorin principles are classical; originality is limited to the exact Gaussian all-face equivalence, conditional attractor count, and sharp probability law in this specific evolutionary-game ensemble.
Search, partition, and nonappearance of a theorem cannot prove historical uniqueness; independent audit remains unperformed.

value.rationale: The complete probability of realizing the maximal one-equilibrium-per-face phase is a natural intrinsic invariant of random interacting evolutionary games. Its sharp m²log m asymptotics and conditional 2^K attractor law quantify simultaneous equilibrium proliferation and its mathematical scarcity, beyond classical diagonal dominance and separate candidate statistics; the exact 1/36 two-population probability explains an independently reported simulation frequency.
